title: MODE 3: VERIF (Verify)
summary: Test equalities and inequalities; result is TRUE or FALSE.

body.text: Build left expression, insert a relation from SHIFT 3 (VERIFY), then the right expression. One relation per statement. Missing terms or multiple relations cause Syntax ERROR.

body.caption: On the unit circle, the 30° right triangle has legs sin 30 and cos 30. VERIF confirms their squares add to 1 under the current angle unit.

body.text: Confirm Deg/Rad before trig identities. VERIF checks numerical/logical truth under current settings, not algebraic proof steps for markers.
